summary: rustfs local-dev container crash-looped 80 times: [FATAL] Server runtime failed: Io error: Permission denied (os error 13)
evidence: Named volume buttery_buttery_s3 was created by the previous local-s3 service (runs as root) and its /data + /data/buttery-uploads were owned by root:root. rustfs/rustfs:latest runs as uid 10001 and cannot write there. The image entrypoint only chowns a data dir it had to create itself, so an existing root-owned dir is never repaired. Reproduced: 'docker run --rm -v buttery_buttery_s3:/data rustfs/rustfs:latest' fails identically, while the same command on a fresh volume boots and yields /data owned 10001:10001.
